fields.description: Alaiy's pooled key is used when this is blank on a workspace's own settings (enterprise override).
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Derived automatically from Refill Rate (tokens/min) after every real API call -- Keepa's own response never names a tier, so this is inferred from published rates (~2=Free, ~5=Basic, ~22=Professional, ~67=Business). Read-only; not something to set by hand.
fields.label: Plan Tier (inferred)

fields.description: Amazon marketplace used when a call does not specify one. 1=US 2=UK 3=DE 4=FR 5=JP 6=CA 8=IT 9=ES 10=IN 11=MX.
fields.label: Default Domain

fields.description: Price/BSR/review/rating history does not change minute to minute -- a product lookup within this window is served from Keepa Product Cache instead of spending a token.
fields.label: History Cache (hours)

fields.description: Live offers and deals move faster than history -- cached for a shorter window.
fields.label: Offers/Deals Cache (hours)

fields.description: Written from the tokensLeft field on every Keepa API response -- the bucket's own authoritative balance, not something computed from Plan Tier.
fields.label: Tokens Left

fields.description: Tokens generated per minute, per the API's own refillRate.
fields.label: Refill Rate (tokens/min)

fields.description: Milliseconds until the next refill, per the API's own refillIn.
fields.label: Refill In (ms)

fields.description: How often to refresh every ASIN on the watchlist (Keepa Watchlist Item) in the background, independent of on-demand Ask Alaiy queries.
fields.label: Watchlist Sync Interval
